For the past twenty-five years, this little radio show has been a quiet companion for people driving home late at night, through rain and sunshine, across every season, and somehow the simple act of talking into a microphone every evening still feels just as meaningful as it did on the very first broadcast, when nobody was listening except one sleepy taxi driver who called in to say thank you.
